## Biography

The Sanguineous Rim is a galactic region on the fringes of the Milky Way. In July 3312, Vista Genomics launched an exploration initiative there in partnership with Faulcon DeLacy, using the new Nomad ship-launched vessel to test its capabilities in extreme terrain and gather biological samples to assess genetic diversity beyond the core systems.
